cases.sentence: Говорю вам, что многие из ___ придут с востока и запада, займут свои места на пиру с Авраамом, Исааком и Иаковом в Небесном Царстве.
cases.explain: «других народов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

cases.sentence: Когда Иисус увидел, что вокруг Него собралась ___, Он велел ученикам переправиться на другую сторону озера.
cases.explain: «большая толпа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

cases.explain: «другой человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

cases.sentence: Внезапно на озере поднялся такой ___, что лодку захлестывало волнами.
cases.explain: «сильный шторм» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

cases.sentence: Когда Иисус прибыл на другую сторону озера, в Гадаринскую землю, навстречу Ему из ___ вышли два человека, одержимых демонами.
cases.explain: «могильных пещер» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes,  two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

cases.explain: «большое стадо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
